description: Checks if the adapter version specified in the integration config is deprecated, sunset, or absent from the catalog before making any API call. If the requested version is deprecated and a stable alternative exists, it automatically overrides to the latest non-deprecated stable version and logs the substitution with a reason. Non-blocking — if no stable override is available, it attaches a warning to the simulation report and allows the pipeline to continue with the selected version. Prevents integrations from silently using expired API versions that may be shut down, reducing production outage risk.
use_cases: Auto-upgrading deprecated CIBIL v1 to stable v3
Detecting sunset Experian v2 and switching to v3
Flagging beta version usage for review before production
Warning when a BRD requests a version not in the catalog
Audit trail of all version overrides for compliance review
when_to_use: Attach to all adapters. Runs after credential_resolve_hook and before pre_validation_hook to ensure the correct version is used before any validation occurs.
trigger_condition: Before every adapter call, after credential resolution

input_parameters.description: Adapter name to check version for
Version specified in the integration config
Array of all versions from the adapter catalog JSON
True if selected version is marked deprecated in catalog

output.on_success: Version confirmed or version_override applied with substitution reason logged
output.on_failure: Version warning attached to simulation report; pipeline continues with selected version

error_codes.HOOK_001: Provided version not found in catalog.
error_codes.HOOK_003: Auto-upgrade schema incompatible; falling back to deprecated version.
